promoted.name: Budget preparation and reporting
promoted.definition: Collecting staffing needs and drafts for the next year's budget and distributing budget versus actual and O&M budget reports to managers.

promoted.name: Auditor request support
promoted.definition: Answering external auditors' testing requests for deal tickets, P&L top pages, valuations and deal support, and delegating them within the desk.

promoted.name: Book officialization
promoted.definition: Marking trading books official each night, listing the books officialized for a desk and following guidance so credit data is right.

promoted.name: Contingency seat planning
promoted.definition: Planning backup seats and away-from-office operation for the desks: collecting seat counts, surveying how work would run and assigning and testing backup seats.

promoted.name: Contract administration
promoted.definition: Processing, amending, extending, routing for signature, credit-approving, tracking and terminating pipeline and transport contracts, and reporting their status.

promoted.name: Cost center charge review and allocation
promoted.definition: Reviewing charges and labor distribution on cost center reports, setting monthly cost allocation percentages and asking for corrections.

promoted.name: Counterparty trading status notices
promoted.definition: Telling traders which counterparties are cleared, halted or suspended, and passing on counterparty termination and delivery suspension notices.

promoted.name: Forward curve validation review
promoted.definition: Explaining to the validation group why monthly forward gas curves changed shape or level.

promoted.name: Customer event planning
promoted.definition: Organizing customer trips, appreciation meetings and happy hours: proposals, guest lists, invitations, RSVPs, rooming lists and itineraries.

promoted.name: Customer origination outreach
promoted.definition: Following up customer leads, preparing customer and opportunity meetings, gathering market data for customers and pitching new products and term deals.

promoted.name: Customer price quote requests
promoted.definition: Getting trader bids and quotes for customers' fixed forward, hedge and firm gas requests and handling close-outs of forward contracts.

promoted.name: Daily model and report distribution
promoted.definition: Sending the daily models, reconciliation sheets, hourly data files and market price reports to settlement, external and desk contacts and keeping recipient lists correct.

promoted.name: Deal confirmation
promoted.definition: Sending, requesting and chasing written confirmations of gas sales and purchases with counterparties and internal groups.

promoted.name: Deal entry and pathing
promoted.definition: Entering requested purchase, sale, storage and buyback deals in the scheduling system and pathing them against transport and market deals so volumes balance.

promoted.name: Deal entry standards and booking guidance
promoted.definition: Setting, reminding staff of and answering questions about the rules for how deals are entered, linked, classified and changed in the deal systems.

promoted.name: Deal ticket lookup
promoted.definition: Finding deal, ticket or TAGG numbers and counterparty names across the deal systems for colleagues who ask for them.

promoted.name: Desk equipment and phone set-up
promoted.definition: Ordering, installing and tracking desk PCs, turrets, phones, headsets and mobile phone plans, and confirming receipt of ordered equipment.

promoted.name: Desk responsibility assignment
promoted.definition: Assigning and announcing which scheduler, trader or analyst handles which pipelines, meters, books and counterparties, and handing work over when duties change.

promoted.name: Employee record and payroll changes
promoted.definition: Asking HR to change employee records, supervisors, operating companies, payroll deductions and separation entitlements, and handling departures.

promoted.name: Internal annuity booking
promoted.definition: Explaining, entering and revising internal annuity deals that move revenue between books, and reviewing prior month adjustments before month-end P&L.

promoted.name: ISO adjustment and decremental bidding
promoted.definition: Setting up, explaining and running decremental and tiered adjustment bids in the ISO markets, including on behalf of generators.

promoted.name: Ledger review and write-offs
promoted.definition: Reviewing preliminary ledgers and inventory schedules and researching and processing volume and general ledger write-offs.

promoted.name: Liquidation support
promoted.definition: Supplying the supporting detail and volume files behind monthly liquidation values to risk and accounting contacts.

promoted.name: Meeting scheduling
promoted.definition: Scheduling management, team and customer meetings, calls and off-sites, booking rooms and collecting attendance replies.

promoted.name: Meter allocation set-up and correction
promoted.definition: Setting and correcting how a meter's monthly volumes are allocated among deals, contracts and parties, including rankings, percentages and volume overrides.

promoted.name: Meter and point facility set-up
promoted.definition: Creating, changing and verifying meter and point records in the facilities and scheduling systems, including replacements, zones and estimate files.

promoted.name: Monthly deal spreadsheet update
promoted.definition: Updating and circulating the monthly spreadsheets and industrial reports of deals and splits for the desk.

promoted.name: Office move coordination
promoted.definition: Scheduling staff office moves, passing on packing and labelling instructions and clearing out vacated desks.

promoted.name: Origination credit booking
promoted.definition: Granting, checking and correcting origination credit on deals and books, and keeping the origination schedule and daily origination report accurate.

promoted.name: Ownership transition handover
promoted.definition: Planning and carrying out the handover of a business or pipeline to a new owner: issue lists, deal lists, data and system migration, staff onboarding and liquidation steps.

promoted.name: Power project contract administration
promoted.definition: Handling a power plant project's agreement notices, change orders, equipment delivery schedules, subcontractor terms and status questions.

promoted.name: Price index evaluation
promoted.definition: Evaluating third-party hourly and real-time power price indexes, their definitions and templates, and deciding on participation.

promoted.name: Real-time desk briefing
promoted.definition: Briefing the real-time desk on transmission paths and prices, outage reporting, market changes and handling rules, and updating its information packet.

promoted.name: Schedule C notices
promoted.definition: Telling risk contacts when amounts are put on, removed from or released from Schedule C.

promoted.name: Staff and analyst recruiting
promoted.definition: Requesting and approving headcount, placing rotating analysts, posting openings, referring candidates and scheduling interviews and feedback with HR.

promoted.name: Staff training coordination
promoted.definition: Arranging training classes, system sessions and presentations for desk staff, choosing topics, enrolling attendees and approving course registrations.

promoted.name: Supply change notices
promoted.definition: Telling logistics about changes to gas supply: new wells, continued deals, plant processing elections and where a producer's gas should flow.

promoted.name: Time off approval
promoted.definition: Employees requesting vacation or days off and managers approving dates and updating the vacation calendar.

promoted.name: Trade tape retrieval
promoted.definition: Arranging for recorded trader calls to be pulled to verify a trade or resolve a dispute with a counterparty.

promoted.name: Transport rate and usage ticket maintenance
promoted.definition: Entering and updating monthly transport usage tickets, service rates, demand charges and finalized invoice amounts on deals, and correcting wrong rates.
